page.overview:
Who is Westervliet?

Admiral Westervliet was a Starfleet Command flag officer during the 2260s.

Westervliet sent orders via a video screen removing the Enterprise from responsibility for the asteroid spaceship Yonada in 2268 after James Kirk initially proved unable to divert its course from inhabited Daran V system. ()

Westervliet was played by Byron Morrow, who previously appeared as another admiral, James Komack, in . Westervliet's name was only given in the episode's end credits. The name was previously referenced in some earlier scripts for "Amok Time." According to the de Forest Research review of the draft of the script for "Amok Time", the following was noted of the proposed name "Admiral Westervliet": "There is a serving Captain in the United States Navy, . To avoid conflicts, suggest: Komack, used in previous scripts." Consequently, the script [https://tvwriting.co.uk/tv_scripts/Collections/Drama/Star_Trek/1_Original_Series/Star_Trek_2x01_-_Amok_Time.pdf revision] prominently stated "Please change the name WESTERVLIET to KOMACK wherever it appears in script."

The FASA role-playing game supplement "The Four Years War" has several essays on that conflict written by him, it mentions that he was a captain during that war and his name is Sebastian Westervliet.
